prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1395; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for damages.

Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person, and refer any inquiries from your insured or their representatives to us.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or telematics records, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written confirmation of receipt of this letter.
